data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element. This design system uses Tailwind CSS utility classes for shadows (shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-2xl, drop-shadow-xl) rather than explicit box-shadow CSS values.

levels.name: Medium Shadow
levels.description: Tailwind shadow-md utility - subtle medium elevation shadow for interactive elements

levels.name: Large Shadow
levels.description: Tailwind shadow-lg utility - elevated shadow for hover states on interactive elements

levels.name: Extra Large Shadow
levels.description: Tailwind shadow-2xl utility with custom shadow-black/50 - dramatic elevation for hover states on cards

levels.name: Drop Shadow XL
levels.description: Tailwind drop-shadow-xl filter utility - large drop shadow for floating container elements
